title: saját élet: A Life of Her Own

sections.title: An old word and a new one
sections.content: You know *saját* ("own") from A1. It joins *élet* ("life") as *saját élet* — "a life of one's own". Add a possessive suffix the way you already do everywhere else: *saját életem* ("my own life").

items.english: Now I have a life of my own here, not just Károly's.

items.spanish: Vannak saját barátaim, akik nem csak Károly barátai.
items.english: I have friends of my own, who aren't just Károly's friends.

sections.content: *saját* goes before the noun, and the noun keeps its possessive ending: *saját életem*, *saját barátaim*.
